items.definition: The busy time of day when many people are traveling to or from work, usually in the morning or evening.
items.example: I hate driving during rush hour because the traffic is so bad.

items.definition: Happening or existing often; found in many places or situations; not rare or unusual.
items.example: It's common for people to feel nervous before a job interview.

items.definition: A reflexive pronoun used when a male person or animal does something to or for himself, or to emphasize that he did it alone.
items.example: He built the bookshelf himself without any help.

items.definition: During the dark hours when the sun has gone down; in the evening or during sleeping hours.
items.example: Many animals are more active at night than during the day.

items.definition: Looking after children while their parents are away, usually for a few hours.
items.example: She earns money by babysitting for families in her neighborhood.

items.definition: A statement indicating that the speaker and at least one other person have not arrived on time.
items.example: We are late for the meeting, so we need to hurry up.

items.definition: Feeling responsible for something bad or wrong that you have done; having broken a rule or law.
items.example: He felt guilty after he forgot his friend's birthday.

items.definition: To tell someone you are sorry for something you have done wrong.
items.example: She apologized for arriving late to the dinner.
items.wordFormationSentence: He gave a sincere ___ for his behavior.

items.definition: Required to do something or having control over something as part of your duty; able to be trusted to do what is right.
items.example: My older brother is responsible for helping with the housework.
items.prepositionSentence: Who is responsible ___ cleaning the kitchen?

items.definition: A way of saying what you believe to be true, based on what you have heard or read, but you may not be completely certain.
items.example: As I understand, the meeting has been moved to next week.

items.definition: A tool or piece of equipment that is designed to do a particular job.
items.example: A smartphone is a useful device for staying in touch with friends.

items.definition: A series of fixed surfaces for climbing up or down between levels; or individual actions you take to reach a goal.
items.example: She walked up the steps to the front door of the house.

items.definition: To remove your shoes from your feet.
items.example: Please take off your shoes when you enter the house.

items.definition: The small leftover pieces of cigarettes after they have been smoked.
items.example: There were cigarette ends in the ashtray on the table.
